title: Actual finite-Q3 split-step recurrence parameter stress
question: Do the actual finite-Q3 split-step four-context recurrence rows remain nonpositive when source support, beta, and finite volume/shape are varied?
method: Rebuild the canonical quartic Q3 Hamiltonian independently on the target edge, square face, and 2x3 rectangular grid with oscillator truncation 3.
Evaluate source words exp(i q_0/3) and exp(i(q_0+q_1)/3) at beta in {1/2,1,2}.
Construct exact matrix exponentials for all onsite and lexicographic bond terms in both declared product orders, for both real-time signs and both A/A* contexts.
Measure the two-sided Gibbs q/p commutator seminorm for two split steps and test the registered local recurrence at every site and step.
Reconstruct the same grid in a separate implementation and compile the rational fixture cross-check in Lean R354.
finding: The primary lane passes 487/487 assertions and the independent lane passes 470/470. Both cover 144 parameter/context histories, 1728 length rows and 1152 recurrence rows. The integrated verifier passes 444/444 with Lean R354 PASS. No recurrence residual exceeds the 1e-9 threshold. The primary maximum residual is 2.3028728945237117e-14, the minimum is -0.07221929223985579, and the beta-wise maxima are 2.1538594548489452e-14 (1/2), 2.1890950777805194e-14 (1), and 2.3028728945237117e-14 (2).
decision_reason: The parameter stress removes beta and source-support variation as immediate finite-grid counterexamples to the declared split-step recurrence, while preserving exact split-product construction and independent agreement. The residuals at the largest positive scale are numerical roundoff, not an analytic sign margin. The pass is therefore a finite input-strengthening checkpoint and cannot be promoted to a uniform recurrence theorem.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing finite actual-Q3 split-step stress. It does not prove a common-core recurrence, volume/cutoff/beta uniformity, an exhaustion Cauchy estimate, a thermodynamic dynamics, a common alpha, Hamiltonian-to-OS identification, KMS/GNS gap, continuum, C6, Sector A, Pre-A or a Clay result.

adversarial_review.check: Only volumes 2,4,6, two steps, three beta values and two source supports are sampled; no volume/cutoff/beta supremum is taken.
The largest positive residual is about 2.3e-14 while the acceptance threshold is 1e-9; this is recorded as tolerance-level roundoff, not exact nonpositivity.
Every tested history uses exact onsite-plus-bond split products in both orders; no unsplit Hamiltonian flow is substituted.
adversarial_review.disposition: DISMISSED for this finite construction; analytic split recurrence remains open

adversarial_review.check: Initial outside-support commutators are checked at every beta and volume, but locality of the infinite-volume algebra is not inferred.
R354 proves only rational parameter-grid and scope fixtures; Python carries the matrix evidence.
No word-wise exhaustion convergence, common carrier, action intertwining, OS/KMS limit, GNS gap or continuum statement is present.
No heat_root_incidence or canonical A1/R-192 production owner is supplied.

qft_interface.closed: A reproducible finite split-step recurrence stress survives the declared beta, source-support, volume/shape, sign, adjoint and order grid, with independent reconstruction and Lean fixture support.
qft_interface.open: An analytic common-core recurrence, volume/cutoff/beta-uniform bound, boundary commutator decay, exhaustion-compatible common word map, Hamiltonian-to-OS action intertwining, common alpha, KMS/GNS identification, phasewise gap and continuum remain open.
qft_interface.tect_boundary: Auxiliary C6/Q3 finite evidence only; no heat_root_incidence, canonical A1/R-192 production owner, physical-empty reference or Sector-A closure is supplied.

next_action: Use the finite stress only as input and attack a source-, volume-, cutoff- and beta-uniform common-core recurrence; if that estimate fails, append its exact route-local obstruction before common-alpha or GNS-gap promotion.
